production.title: Status Page - Exa
production.bodyText:
Exa publishes service availability at status.exa.ai: the current state of the Search API, Websets, and Exa MCP, active incidents with updates as they progress, and 90 days of uptime history.
All systems operational
status.exa.ai ↗
Search API
Operational
Websets
Operational
Exa MCP
Operational
Agents API
Operational
Checked 5:42:38 PM · refreshes every 5 minutes
​
Subscribe to updates
Subscribe on the status page to be notified when an incident is opened, updated, or resolved. Notifications are delivered by email, Slack, Google Chat, or webhook.
​
Get help
If requests keep failing while all systems report operational, the cause is likely request-level — check Error codes first.
Email support
Send the response status, error body, and requestId for the fastest diagnosis.
Email support
Enterprise support
Uptime and support SLAs are available on Enterprise plans.
